correctness.rationale: For p=2, n=3 and (j0,j1,j2)=(1,1,1), six-dimensional mixed volume equals 4^6/6! times a six-vector determinant expectation. Multilinear determinant is exactly a scalar triple product of pairwise cross products, exhaustively checked on 3^6=729 basis tuples. Uniform spherical cross magnitudes give (pi/4)^3, angular sine another pi/4, and absolute cosine 1/2, yielding pi^4/90 for the unit ball. Block-diagonal affine scaling by T direct-sum T yields W=(pi^2/160)|E|^2 for every full ellipsoid. Universal Janson bound 3/10 leads to ratio pi^2/48. No sampling is used to establish the angular integrals.
